title: claude-gateway App Store registry
description: Schema for apps.json — the central catalog of the getpod App Store. Backward-compatible with the gateway registry parser (name, description, repo, versions[]).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last catalog change.

categories.description: Single source of truth for allowed app categories. Every app.category must be a member of this list. Required so the CI enum check can never be silently disabled by removing it.

name.description: Globally unique RFC1123-ish slug. Also the image folder name (apps/<name>/).

tagline.description: Short one-liner shown under the name.

repo.description: GitHub repository URL. Must include an owner and repo path (not a bare host).

category.description: Required for newly published apps. Must be a member of the top-level categories[] enum (enforced by the CI script).

icon.description: Repo-relative path to the app icon, e.g. apps/<name>/icon.png.

versions.description: Append-only version history. New versions are added to the end; old ones are kept.

commit.description: Full 40-char git commit hash pinned at approval time.

approved_at.description: Date the admin approved this version (YYYY-MM-DD).
